basic_info.description: Welcome to 220 Delano Avenue - Your Happy Place in Mission Terrace! Step into charm, character, and comfort at this delightful 1924 single-family gem, nestled in the heart of San Francisco's friendly and commuter-smart Mission Terrace neighborhood. This two-level home offers 3 sunny bedrooms with views of the surrounding hills and out to the Bay and 1 full bathroom upstairs. Enjoy morning coffee in the bright living area with classic period details, or whip up something delicious in the cheerful kitchen before heading out for the day. Garage parking? Absolutely. Though you might not need it as you're just blocks from Balboa Park, BART, and local shops, with easy access to all the best of the city. Whether you're a first-time buyer or looking for a home with a little extra personality, 220 Delano Avenue delivers comfort, charm, and just the right dash of vintage flair. Come say hello. Your happy home awaits!
